The way back
To come back later, do the same on the other handheld: open this game, choose Continue on another handheld and send it back. The save returns the same way.
The newest save is on the handheld you played on last. Before anything moves, Valkyr compares the saves on this handheld and on RomM, and asks you when both have changed.
